description:
Profluent is the frontier AI lab for biology. Profluent builds powerful foundation models for all of life's molecules, unlocking solutions that transform medicine, agriculture, and beyond. Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Emeryville, CA, Profluent is backed by leading investors including Altimeter Capital, Bezos Expeditions, Spark Capital, Insight Partners, Air Street Capital, AIX Ventures, and Convergent Ventures and has raised over $150M to date.

 We're looking for a motivated and creative Machine Learning (ML) Scientist to drive research into biomolecular structure prediction. You will build and improve all-atom co-folding models, with a focus on the complexes that matter most to our programs: antibody–antigen interfaces and protein–nucleic acid assemblies. These remain among the hardest cases for current models, and closing that gap directly accelerates our antibody design and genome editing work.

 The ideal candidate has trained structure prediction models at a leading academic or industry lab and knows where today's models break. You will be a self-directed researcher who moves quickly from hypothesis to trained model to rigorous evaluation. As an early member of the ML team, you will help shape how structure modeling fits alongside our generative models (ProGen3, E1) and experimental platforms.

 Responsibilities 

 
 Develop and train all-atom structure prediction models, improving accuracy on antibody–antigen and protein–nucleic acid complexes

 Diagnose failure modes of current models (e.g., CDR-H3 and epitope placement, interface geometry, nucleic acid conformations, confidence calibration) and design architecture, training, and data interventions to address them

 Curate large-scale training data from structural databases, distillation sets, and Profluent's own experimental binding and function data

 Integrate structure models with our generative models for design and filtering, and work with protein design teams on experimental validation

 Present results to colleagues in regular update meetings

 
 Qualifications 

 
 PhD (or equivalent industry experience) in computer science, computational biology, biophysics, or a related field

 Hands-on experience building and training biomolecular structure prediction models (e.g., AlphaFold- or Protenix-style co-folding models) at a leading academic or industry lab

 Publications at major ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) or top science journals, or widely used open-source models

 Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX, including multi-GPU training

 
 Preferences 

 
 Experience modeling antibody structure and antibody–antigen docking, including CDR loop modeling and epitope prediction

 Experience modeling protein–DNA or protein–RNA complexes

 Deep familiarity with structural data pipelines: mmCIF processing, MSA and template search, structural clustering, and dataset splitting

 Experience with diffusion or flow-matching models for structure generation or structure-conditioned design

 Experience with large-scale distributed training and cloud compute

 Familiarity with experimental structural and binding data (cryo-EM, crystallography, display-based binding assays)

 
 What We Offer  

 
 High-growth opportunity with meaningful impact on the future of protein design

 Competitive compensation package with equity participation

 401(k) with a strong employer match

 Comprehensive benefits including health/dental/vision insurance

 Generous PTO policy and commitment to work-life balance

 Professional development opportunities in a cutting-edge field at the intersection of AI and biology

 
 Profluent Bio, Inc is an equal opportunity employer promoting diversity and inclusion in the workspace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical conditions, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender (including gender identity and gender expression), sex (which includes pregnancy, childbirth, and breastfeeding), genetic information, taking or requesting statutorily protected leave, or any other basis protected by law.

 Employment Eligibility Verification 

 Legal authorization to work in the United States is required. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired must verify their identity and work eligibility and complete the required employment verification form upon hire.
 Hiring Salary Range
 $212,000 — $339,000 USD 


 NOTICE TO STAFFING AND SEARCH FIRMS: Profluent does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions. We ask that agencies refrain from sending resumes to our careers inbox, hiring managers, or any Profluent employee. Any resume submitted without a signed agreement and an active search request from our Talent team will be treated as the property of Profluent, and no placement fee will be owed.
